limits: This PASS applies only to these exact outside helper/test hashes and aggregate-export integrity. It does not amend the running model, authorization, frozen research or compute budget, and creates no training/retry authority.

No real campaign metrics or results were inspected. Actual export after process exit must pass the same checks; this review is not a claim that the running campaign has completed or obtained any predictive score.

Evidence integrity trusts the reviewed producer and local account. Hash-consistent fabricated input trees are not cryptographically authenticated by these helpers. A current matching main export is required for condition publication.

Exporter validates/copies recorded selection; it does not rerun the model-ranking search or independently derive F1/MAE from raw sample labels/predictions. Full-grid formulas are checked using stored condition metrics and frozen aggregate implementation.

Optimizer-entry markers alone do not prove a successful step; exported successful_optimizer_step_proven and completed epoch records distinguish this. Failed or missing-terminal runs must not be summarized as completed.

Malformed/torn JSONL or missing necessary terminal/checkpoint evidence is rejected. Recovering aggregate evidence after an abrupt crash may need a separate bounded evidence-handling review; no retries or fabricated events are authorized.
Synthetic payload sizes are not universal upper bounds; actual generated public artifacts still require the publication safety/size gate.
Repeated VALID selection optimism remains. Three-seed SD is descriptive and does not establish significance, held-out TEST performance or special-set generalization.
